summary: Cambridge's EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (NanoDTC) has opened applications for its interdisciplinary MRes+PhD in nanoscience and nanotechnology, starting in October 2027. The first internal review deadline is 8 December 2026, with a second deadline on 2 January 2027.
highlights: Interdisciplinary MRes+PhD in nanoscience and nanotechnology, starting October 2027.
Submit by 2 January 2027 to be considered for full University-based funding (NanoDTC page).
University funding pages list 6 January 2027 instead; verify the current dates on the official NanoDTC page before applying.
